app.title: NEXUS AI/ML
app.subtitle: Your engineering journey, measured in progress.

weeks.title: Full Python
weeks.description: Build confident Python programming skills and learn the data stack used in AI/ML.
topics: Python setup, syntax, variables and data types
For loops, while loops, break and continue
Strings, indexing, slicing and string methods
Functions, parameters, return values and scope
Modules, packages, pip and virtual environments
File handling: TXT, CSV and JSON
OOP: classes, objects, constructors and methods
NumPy: arrays, indexing, slicing and broadcasting
Pandas: Series, DataFrames, filtering and missing values
Matplotlib: line, bar, histogram and scatter plots
targets: Push notebooks and code to GitHub

weeks.title: Mathematics for AI/ML
weeks.description: Understand the mathematics behind data analysis, model training and evaluation.
topics: Descriptive statistics: mean, median, mode and percentiles
Dot product, transpose and identity matrix
Partial derivatives and chain rule intuition
Implement statistics from scratch using Python
targets: Implement mean, variance and standard deviation in Python
Implement a simple gradient descent routine
Explain vectors, matrices, probability and derivatives

weeks.title: Artificial Intelligence Fundamentals
weeks.description: Learn how intelligent agents solve problems, search state spaces and make decisions.
topics: AI vs Machine Learning vs Deep Learning vs Generative AI
Heuristic search and greedy best-first search
Ethics, bias, privacy and responsible AI
targets: Implement A* on a small graph
Explain intelligent agents and search strategies

weeks.title: Machine Learning Fundamentals
weeks.description: Learn the end-to-end machine learning workflow and foundational algorithms.
topics: What is Machine Learning and common use cases
Supervised, unsupervised and reinforcement learning overview
ML workflow: problem, data, model and evaluation
Datasets, features, labels and data leakage
Cost functions and gradient descent intuition
targets: Train one regression and one classification model
Push a reproducible notebook to GitHub

weeks.title: Advanced Machine Learning
weeks.description: Compare algorithms, tune models and evaluate them reliably.
targets: Implement at least six ML algorithms
Write a clear model evaluation report

weeks.title: Deep Learning
weeks.description: Understand neural networks and train a first deep learning model.
topics: Activation functions: ReLU, sigmoid, tanh and softmax
Batch size, epochs and learning rate
Build, train and evaluate a PyTorch model

weeks.title: NLP & Computer Vision
weeks.description: Explore language and image data with practical introductory applications.
topics: Computer vision fundamentals and image representation
Pixels, channels, colour spaces and resizing
Object detection concepts and evaluation overview
targets: Use OpenCV for basic image processing

weeks.title: Generative AI & AI Engineering
weeks.description: Connect modern AI models to useful applications and learn deployment basics.
topics: Generative AI concepts and use cases
RAG architecture: ingestion, chunking and retrieval
Build a basic document Q&A workflow
targets: Build a basic document Q&A assistant

weeks.title: Portfolio Project 01 — Customer Churn
weeks.description: Build a complete classical ML application from dataset to deployed interface.
topics: Define the customer churn problem and success metric
Find and inspect a suitable public dataset
Perform data cleaning and exploratory analysis
Prepare features and prevent data leakage
Train and compare a Random Forest model
Evaluate precision, recall, F1 and confusion matrix
Tune hyperparameters and select a model
Write README, usage instructions and limitations
targets: Complete end-to-end Customer Churn Prediction project
Include reproducible training and inference code
Publish repository with screenshots and README

weeks.title: Portfolio Project 02 — Image Classification
weeks.description: Build and explain a deep learning image classifier.
topics: Choose a manageable public image dataset
Inspect class balance and image quality
Create train, validation and test splits
Create a baseline CNN or use transfer learning
Train model and monitor loss curves
targets: Save model weights and inference code

weeks.title: Portfolio Project 03 — AI Document Q&A
weeks.description: Build a grounded document assistant using retrieval-augmented generation.
topics: Define supported document types and user flow
Connect an LLM for grounded answer generation
Show source snippets or page references
Handle empty retrieval and unsupported questions
targets: Complete a working PDF Document Q&A assistant
Test with questions answerable and unanswerable from documents

weeks.title: Deployment, GitHub & Job Preparation
weeks.description: Polish projects, demonstrate engineering ability and prepare for entry-level roles.
topics: Refactor project structure and remove unused files
Use Git branches and meaningful commits
Add input validation and basic tests
Deploy applications and verify live links
Learn Docker build and run workflow
Revise Python, SQL, statistics and ML interview topics
Practise project walkthroughs and mock interviews
targets: Deploy working project demos where feasible
Practise at least two mock interviews
Apply to relevant entry-level AI/ML roles
